title: Blooming Lite
description: Follow the quest, expand your world, don't die | Various challenges to choose in game! | Less Intensive!
body:
Blooming Lite is just Blooming, but better on performance! This is done by having less mods and less quests. This also grants an experience closer to Vanilla than Blooming Original.

]

Hordes Tables [

Hard & Medium & Easy Table – Removed Zoglins, Magma Cubes, Hoglins, Piglins, Blazes, Piglin Brutes, and Wither Skeletons.

Adjusted first appearance in Horde days for almost all mobs in all tables.

Added a Very Easy Horde.

]

Updated the message to reflect the new questing mod.

]

Starter Kit [

Gives all players 4 Lights, to be used for settings with new quests mod. All 4 may be needed by Admins / Singleplayer. Only 1 will be necessary for everyone else. Enjoy the free lights!

] 


}

What you see below is a modified version of the Blooming description to fit Blooming Lite!

![Blooming Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/460b2a0b17cc46dd3c52ecfa57a51d194c14c539.png)

A questing modpack that has over 100 different vanilla advancement based quest to expand your world.

The ultimate goal is to complete all of the advancements and unlock the entirety of your world!

Challenges include {
- Required Challenge: Hordes - Raid style hordes who's frequency and composition will change depending on the downloaded difficulty of the modpack.
- Required Challenge: Blooming World - A worldborder starting at 64, 92, or 128 (You're choice)
- Optional Challenge: Screw Your Items - Having your inventory get deleted upon death, but being able to gain keep inventory one slot at a time.

}

The challenges offered (both required and optional) such as Hordes and Screw Your Items are configureable through quests.

<details>
  <summary>Important Notes</summary>
  
  Disregard the squids with glowing that spawn for the first 5-10 days (they should die pretty quick). This is a patchwork fix to the Hordes issue
  

Remove from the server any mods labeled Client Side Only or else the server will crash.

<details>

<summary>Future Plans</summary>

I plan on bringing some of the changes done with Blooming Lite to the other Bloomings! (Boundless Questing, Changed hordes, Vanilla Backport, Meaningful Diamonds, and other things).

Also, I need to continue to fill in the fluff text for all of the advancements in the quests. If you notice that an advancement doesn't have fluff text and you can think of something to put there, please send it in the suggestions chat in our discord. I will credit you.


</details>

<details>

<summary> Other Blooming Variants</summary>

[Blooming](https://modrinth.com/project/qIA2pWGd) - The Original! Blooming Lite is a variant of this one!

[Blooming in Confinement](https://modrinth.com/modpack/blooming-in-confinement) - This variant of Blooming is meant to keep the original intent of Blooming in servers with 4 or more people! (Or you can play it for a harder experience with less people, but this is not recommended).
  
</details>
